Game Overview

Ninja Hero Platformer is a action title where become a valiant ninja in a city under siege, navigating treacherous landscapes and battling fierce foes. Employ swift agility, strategic combat, and smart navigation through traps. Dynamic boss encounters await as you gather items and enhance your score, ensuring a captivating journey for heroic defenders of all ages.
